output.explanation: NIG-SA booked NIG-SA:ICV-SA-018932 at EUR 7,980.00 against NIG-DE's receivable NIG-DE:5100873371 of EUR 8,400.00 for the same invoice RE-2026-000671, both in October. The ratio is 0.95, which matches Saudi 5% WHT on services, and the buyer description says 'net of WHT 5%'. The EUR 420.00 gap (USD 450.00 at the invoice-date rate) is withholding tax, not a pricing or keying error.
output.recommended_action: NIG-SA should gross up the IC payable to EUR 8,400.00 and recognise the EUR 420.00 WHT liability to ZATCA. NIG-DE should reclassify EUR 420.00 of the IC receivable to WHT receivable/tax credit (or expense) once it receives the WHT certificate.
